name: The number of references matches the number of unique inline citations
description: If the analysis text contains inline citations [1], [2], [3], there should be exactly 3 reference entries in the references panel. Mismatched counts indicate broken citation anchors.

planSteps.description: Click on a bracket match to open a match detail page
Count the unique citation numbers visible in the analysis paragraphs (e.g., [1], [2], [3])
Scroll to the References section and count the numbered reference entries

Verify the references section contains at least 1 entry and the number of reference entries is plausibly consistent with the number of unique citation markers seen in the text (within 1-2 of each other). A references panel with 0 entries when citations exist in the text is a failure.
